entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I'm not sure if I'm doing this right. I bought some shoes, and they're just... not right. I think I need to return them, but the website is so overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, I think so... hold on. It's... V-F-5-8-2-1-9-9. Is that it? I get so confused with these things.
Yes, that's perfect. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered on November 1st. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. The cycling shoes.
Okay. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A fault? I don't know. They just hurt. I tried setting up the cleats and it was so difficult, and when I finally went for a ride I got terrible blisters. I just don't think they're for me. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear they caused you blisters and were difficult to set up. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Let me just check our policy against your delivery date.
Okay... I hope it's not too late. I've been so stressed I just kept putting it off.
Not at all. I've just checked, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. So I can send them back? Thank you.

Of course. I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a big help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
